mechanism_narrative: A high level of the federal funds rate (above 3.5%) compresses corporate borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.5% (based on historical data from 2000-2005).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting the Federal Reserve to adopt an accommodative monetary policy stance, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% (based on historical data from 2000-2005).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts above 2000 thousand units and retail sales above 350000 million dollars signals robust consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST > 2000 and RSAFS > 350000 (based on historical data from 2000-2005).

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong industrial production (INDPRO > 115), corporate earnings growth is robust, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO > 115 (based on historical data from 2000-2005).

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth (PAYEMS > 100,000) indicates a robust labor market and rising consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when PAYEMS > 100,000 (based on historical data from 2000-2005).

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 200, it signals persistent inflationary pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 200 (based on historical data from 2000-2005).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) and weak job growth (PAYEMS < 100,000) signals a deteriorating labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0 and PAYEMS < 100000 (based on historical data from 2000-2005).

mechanism_narrative: In a housing boom regime (HOUST > 2000), strong housing activity drives consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST > 2000 (based on historical data from 2000-2005).
